Print method for factor_comparaison

print.factor.comparaison.Rd

Print method for factor_comparaison

Usage

# S3 method for class 'factor.comparaison'
print(x)

Arguments

x

a factor.comparaison class

Value

return a print for the factor_comparaison() result

Examples

data("inference")
items <- c(paste0("item_0",3:9),"item_10")
f <- factor_explorer(inference, items)
ff <- factor_comparison(inference, items, f)
#> Warning: convergence not obtained in GPFoblq. 1000 iterations used.
#> Model 1 = psych::fa(r = data[, items], nfactors = factor)
#> Model 2 = psych::fa(r = data[, items], nfactors = factor)
#> Model 3 = psych::fa(r = data[, items], nfactors = factor)
print(ff)
